title: Ocean Link, the First Private Equity Firm Focused on China's Travel and Tourism Sector, Announces Strategic Partnership with Ctrip and General Atlantic
主要内容: Ocean Link, a private equity firm focused on China's travel and tourism sector, has announced a strategic partnership with Ctrip and General Atlantic. The collaboration aims to leverage Ocean Link's expertise in the travel and tourism industry to support growth opportunities. Ctrip.com International, Ltd. is a leading travel service provider in China, offering accommodation reservation, transportation ticketing, and corporate travel management services. General Atlantic, established in 1980, combines a collaborative global approach, sector-specific expertise, long-term investment horizon, and a deep understanding of growth drivers to partner with great management and build exceptional businesses worldwide. The partnership is positioned to capitalize on the steady growth of China's travel and tourism sector, which has seen significant increases in domestic and international travel numbers over the past decade.
